observed.failureLocation: secondary PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES query during environment collection

causeBoundary: Secondary signature query failure cause was not established. API26 does not have Android11 package visibility rules. This is a report metadata failure and does not imply Python business execution failed.
change: Persist core results before collecting metadata; use signatures returned in WebView provider PackageInfo first; query failure records unavailable/source/error and does not discard core checks. NAS driver also preserves core results if environment collection fails. Product manifest/provider unchanged.
